Future Tech Roadmap

LEO Satellite Internet Constellation Confirmed Ongoing

📈 AST SpaceMobile is building direct-to-smartphone satellite connectivity. Commercial service launched in 2024 via telecoms partnerships. Revenue inflects with satellite count.
